Contact

Location has become essential to how people move, work, and make decisions. Outside, GPS gives us confidence. Inside, that confidence still disappears, leaving people to rely on static maps, memory, staff help, and guesswork.

Businesses feel that blind spot too. Without precise indoor location, teams have limited visibility into movement, workflows, engagement, and space usage.

Oriient was founded in 2016 to solve that gap: accurate indoor location without dedicated hardware. Today, Oriient helps retailers, hospitals, smart buildings, and other complex environments make indoor spaces measurable, navigable, and actionable, so people move with more confidence and teams operate with greater clarity.

Careers

Oriient is built by people who like solving hard, real-world problems. Our team works across product, engineering, operations, and customer success to make indoor location accurate, scalable, and useful in the places where GPS stops.

We look for thoughtful, curious, and collaborative people who want to build technology that works in the real world and creates measurable value for customers.

The Best

Bottom line - we’re a super busy, fast-moving start up with ambitious goals. Regardless of the position, we only take the highest achievers, smartest thinkers, the best of the best – period.

Open Minds

At Oriient, we are building something new and ground-breaking. We are challenged daily with creating and exploring new possibilities that extend beyond our mental comfort-zone- and we look for people who are capable of full-on intellectual creativity and flexibility.

Hunger

Not only do we bond over a love of food here at Oriient (except that one person who hates cheese…), what characterizes our team is a hunger to learn, participate and be challenged. We’re preserving and recruiting only those that are truly fueled by this spirit.

Fun

Things move fast here at Oriient, so we work hard, but also understand and fully participate in the recharging benefits of having fun! Keeping things fresh and truly appreciating each other’s company. As a tight-knit team, it’s important that team members are equally as weird as the rest of us, and enjoy having a laugh, drinking a beer, and taking a breath as a family.
